import os

import requests
from flask import Blueprint, jsonify, request

bp = Blueprint('items', __name__)

UPSTREAM_URL = 'https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather'


@bp.get('/api/weather')
def get_weather():
    city = request.args.get('city', '').strip()
    if not city:
        return jsonify({'error': 'city is required'}), 400

    api_key = os.environ.get('OPENWEATHER_API_KEY')
    if not api_key:
        return jsonify({'error': 'OPENWEATHER_API_KEY not set'}), 500

    params = {
        'q': city,
        'appid': api_key,
        'units': 'imperial'
    }

    try:
        upstream = requests.get(UPSTREAM_URL, params=params, timeout=5)
    except requests.RequestException:
        return jsonify({'error': 'weather service unavailable'}), 502

    if upstream.status_code == 404:
        return jsonify({'error': 'city not found'}), 404
    if upstream.status_code != 200:
        return jsonify({'error': 'weather service unavailable'}), 502

    data = upstream.json()
    try:
        temp_f = data['main']['temp']
        description = data['weather'][0]['description']
        return jsonify({
            'city': data['name'],
            'temp_f': temp_f,
            'description': description
        }), 200
    except KeyError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid weather data received'}), 500


@bp.get('/')
def index():
    default_city = 'New York'
    return PAGE

PAGE = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Weather Lookup</title></head>
<body>
  <h1>Weather lookup</h1>
  <input id="city" type="text" value="New York">
  <button id="get_weather">Get weather</button>
  <div id="result"></div>
  <script>
    async function getWeather() {
      const city = document.getElementById('city').value.trim();
      const resultDiv = document.getElementById('result');
      if (!city) {
        resultDiv.textContent = 'City name is required';
        return;
      }

      const url = '/api/weather?city=' + encodeURIComponent(city);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url);
        const data = await res.json();

        if (res.ok) {
          resultDiv.innerHTML = `<strong>${data.city}</strong>: ${data.description}, ${Math.round(data.temp_f)}°F`;
        } else if (res.status === 400) {
          resultDiv.textContent = 'City name is required';
        } else if (res.status === 404) {
          resultDiv.textContent = 'City not found';
        } else if (res.status === 502) {
          resultDiv.textContent = 'Weather service unavailable';
        } else {
          // Handles 500 or other errors from the API endpoint
          resultDiv.textContent = data.error || 'An unknown error occurred.';
        }
      } catch (error) {
        resultDiv.textContent = 'Network error: Could not connect to weather service.';
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('get_weather').addEventListener('click', getWeather);
    // On first page load, display default city's weather
    window.onload = () => {
        getWeather();
    };
  </script>
</body>
</html>
"""
